answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 12607 Country: India Title: Is it permitted (DUA MANGNA) in Namaz to get a girl, whom I love? Question: Is it permitted (DUA MANGNA) in Namaz to get a girl, whom I love? Answer ID: 12607 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 726/546=L/1430) It is unlawful to do du?a (supplicate) in salah: ودعا بما شاء بما یشبہ ألفاظ القرآن والأدعیۃ الماثورۃ لا بما یشبہ کلام الناس نحو أللھم ارزقني مالا واللھم زوجني فلانۃ ( ملتقی الأبحر مع مجمع الأنھر 1:153، بیروت ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
